What is VMWare ESXi 7 EOS date
The End of General Support (EoGS) date for VMware ESXi 7.0 Update 3d is October 2, 2025. Technical Guidance is available until April 2, 2027.

The provided database indicates specific dates for End of General Support (EoGS) and Technical Guidance for VMware ESXi products.

*   **End of General Support (EoGS)** is the date when general support for a product version concludes. For VMware ESXi 7.0 Update 3d, this is October 2, 2025.
*   **Technical Guidance** is a subsequent phase after General Support. For VMware ESXi 7.0 Update 3d, this extends until April 2, 2027.
